name: Virtual-Study-Group
description: Real-time collaborative virtual study group platform featuring WebRTC video meetings, peer audio lounge, live whiteboard, code playground, study task planner, AI assistant, and analytics.

paragraphs: A state-of-the-art, real-time virtual study platform built for students and educators. Features interactive study rooms, WebRTC video calls, peer voice lounges, collaborative whiteboards, live code execution, AI-powered study assistance, study analytics, and milestone certificate generation.
features: In-App HD Video Calls: Embedded WebRTC video meeting rooms powered by Jitsi Meet SDK with screen sharing capabilities.
Peer Audio Lounge: Lightweight, low-bandwidth voice channel for instant verbal collaboration.
Live Canvas Whiteboard: Draw formulas, diagram software architectures, and save canvas states directly to cloud storage.
Code Playground: Multi-language code editor (Python & JavaScript) with real-time runtime execution benchmarking in milliseconds.
AI Study Helper: Generates practice exam questions, concept summaries, and step-by-step academic explanations.
